note: Machine-readable, NON-SECRET infrastructure register for the Cloudflare Pages deployment. It records ONLY references — the names of the repo variables / secrets that carry the real production ids and credentials — never a value. The public repo keeps placeholders in wrangler.toml; the real ids are injected at deploy from the referenced variables and the guard fails the deploy closed if any required production id is still a placeholder. Enforced by scripts/check-infra-config.mjs.

requiredProductionIds.description: Production D1 (SQLite) database id for the aggregate-only research store. Injected at deploy from the CF_D1_DATABASE_ID repo variable; the public repo keeps the placeholder so no live id is committed.

Payload-free KV namespace id holding single-use submission-token nonces. NON-PRODUCTION fallback store; production requires the atomic D1 store (research-nonces-d1-database). Injected at deploy from the CF_KV_RESEARCH_NONCES_ID repo variable; the public repo keeps the placeholder.

Production D1 database id for the ATOMIC single-use nonce store — a SEPARATE database from research-d1-database (the aggregate research DB), holding only the payload-free used_nonce table (self-provisioned, never migrated). Required in production: the ingestion endpoints fail closed (503) without it. Injected at deploy from the CF_D1_NONCES_DATABASE_ID repo variable; the public repo keeps the placeholder.

Cloudflare account id. Not secret (it appears in every dashboard URL) but required for any deploy and never hardcoded in the committed config — it is supplied from the CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID repo variable.

secretReferences.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secretReferences.usedBy: Cloudflare Pages deploy (scoped 'Cloudflare Pages: Edit' token)

secretReferences.name: CF_D1_API_TOKEN
secretReferences.usedBy: D1 migrations apply + live-schema read (D1-scoped token, separate from the Pages token)

secretReferences.name: RESEARCH_TOKEN_SECRET
secretReferences.usedBy: HMAC signing secret for single-use research submission tokens (wrangler pages secret put)

secretReferences.name: TURNSTILE_RESEARCH_SECRET
secretReferences.usedBy: Cloudflare Turnstile secret for the token-issue anti-abuse challenge (wrangler pages secret put)

previewIsolation.description: PR previews MUST use a SEPARATE D1 database and KV namespace so preview traffic never mixes into the published dataset. When a preview production/preview id pair is supplied at deploy the two ids must differ; equal ids fail closed.
